meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 WhatsApp 频道:从 channels 分支复制并注册 Baileys 适配器、安装依赖、跑注册测试,再用二维码或配对码把手机上的 WhatsApp 链接过来,并写入 .env 配置。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道、把手机 WhatsApp 链接到它时触发。运行任何安装或认证命令前,它必先问清用的是专用号还是共用号。

say.text: 帮我加 WhatsApp 频道,我用专用号码
say.note: 先确认号码模式,再复制并注册适配器

say.text: 用二维码方式链接 WhatsApp
say.note: 终端显示二维码,用手机扫它
终端显示 8 位配对码,在手机输入

howto.what_en: Adds the native Baileys WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs pinned packages, runs its registration test, then links your phone's WhatsApp via QR or pairing code and writes .env settings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw or link a phone's WhatsApp to it. Before any install or auth command, it asks whether the number is dedicated or shared.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp channel for me, using a dedicated number
say_en.note: Confirms number mode, then copies the adapter

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp with a QR code
say_en.note: Shows a rotating QR in the terminal to scan

say_en.text: Link with a pairing code, my number is 14155551234
say_en.note: Prints an 8-character code to type in WhatsApp
